messages:
maria: Rolling out deferred-prefix-join v1 to canary (eng-runtime) — quick heads up. Initial canary (us-east1) at 3% traffic. Early bench looks promising: p50 and cost both down.
kevin: Nice. raw numbers?
maria: From the quick harness (chat-short, seq=64):
```
Benchmark: chat-short (seq=64)
Baseline  p50=14.1ms  p95=55.6ms  cost=0.137 units
DPJ v1    p50=10.2ms  p95=49.8ms  cost=0.112 units  (-18.2% cost)
```
sasha: Any observable tradeoffs? CPU, memory, or cache churn?
maria: CPU up ~3% on canary hosts, memory +2% peak, but effective KV-prefix hit +3.1 percentage points. No spike in cold-starts.
zoe: What about p99 tail?
maria: p99 unchanged in the harness. Gate for rollout is p99 >7% regression over baseline -> rollback.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started for deferred-prefix-join v1 (3% us-east1) :rocket:
ethan: Ops note — monitor the "prefix-coalescer" and "tokenizer-latency" panels. I added a shortlink on #oncall: https://console.redwood/perf/deferred-prefix-join
ana: Could finance get per-customer delta? some customers we track will care about token cost.
maria: Yes — kicking off per-customer diff job, will drop in #finance in ~45m.
kevin: Are there kernel changes or just runtime?
maria: Runtime-only. Added deferred-join state machine in coalescer, improved seq-aware packing loop, and a small reorder for prefetch calls. No kernel or CUDA driver changes.
kevin: Show me the toggles you flipped.
maria: config we enabled on canary:
```yaml\
enable_deferred_prefix_join: true
deferred_join_max_wait_ms: 8
coalesce_batch_hint: 12
prefix_dedupe_ttl_ms: 1200
```
sasha: Perf QA ran quick smoke and longer jitter tests — no regressions caught. thumbs up from QA :thumbsup:
ana: tiny request — please include per-model and per-tenant cost deltas in the finance report.
maria: Will do. Also ran a quick canary smoke command to flip on/off if needed:
```
$ redwood-admin runtime toggle --feature deferred-prefix-join --env canary --set true
```
ethan: If we observe >7% p99 regression or any error-rate uptick, I'll trigger the rollback playbook and declare an incident. Otherwise proceed with staged rollout. :eyes:
maria: Plan: 3% -> 20% at T+1h -> 50% at T+6h -> 100% at T+48h if no gates tripped. Posting interim metrics at each stage.
perf-bot: Canary smoke checks complete — no regressions in last 20m. :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks team — this should shave both latency and unit cost for chat-short workloads. Will post the 1-hour update here. :party:
